assumptions: No host needs 'another session is active on this scope' facts inside the injected working set; if one does, render an allowlisted subset instead of excluding
context: Applied the review of fix/working-set-render (1258c30a): every free-text field now goes through one oneLine() normaliser, hook bookkeeping observations are excluded from the working set, result.error is never rendered, URL userinfo is stripped, 40-hex result shas shortened. 9 new tests, all red on 1258c30a.
rationale: Reviewer measured on a fixture store: 25 SessionStarts + 10 decisions at the default 6000 budget left 2/10 decisions delivered and the delta cursor pinned, so every UserPromptSubmit re-injected the full ~6.7 KB set. These observations carry cwd, session id, transcript name and injection cursors — plumbing about the injection machinery, the same ground on which receipts were already excluded. A compact one-token render still spends ~95 bytes per session at class rank 2 and stalls the cursor later rather than never; ranking below proposals keeps them competing for budget. Detection is structural: record_type observation, source_kind 'other', result.kind in the named set. New test: 25 sessions (SessionStart + PreCompact each) + 10 decisions → all decisions emitted, nothing omitted, cursor written, both prompt turns are deltas.
summary: Chose to EXCLUDE the hooks' own session_start / compaction / post_compaction observations from the working set (alongside principal, membership, receipt) rather than render them compactly or rank them below proposals
